description: This file manages trace file creation, configuration, and writing for the trace2 subsystem in a Git-related project. It handles file naming, directory checks, socket connections, and trace output.

methods.name: tr2_dst_trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing by closing the file descriptor if needed and resetting state.

methods.name: tr2_dst_too_many_files
methods.description: Checks if the target directory has too many files or if a sentinel file exists, to prevent overloading.

methods.name: tr2_dst_try_auto_path
methods.description: Attempts to create an auto-named trace file in the target directory, handling file count limits.

methods.name: tr2_dst_try_path
methods.description: Opens a specified file path for tracing.

methods.name: tr2_dst_try_unix_domain_socket
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a Unix domain socket for tracing.

methods.name: tr2_dst_malformed_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning for malformed trace target values.

methods.name: tr2_dst_get_trace_fd
methods.description: Determines and returns the file descriptor for tracing based on environment variables or configuration.

methods.name: tr2_dst_trace_want
methods.description: Returns whether tracing is enabled based on the trace file descriptor.

methods.name: tr2_dst_write_line
methods.description: Writes a line to the trace destination, handling errors and disabling tracing if needed.
